brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Build currently has only two occupied levels (level 0: piece:0,0,0;half-n + half-s, level 1: piece:0,0,1;half-n + half-s). Level 2 pieces were removed to resolve loose-body warnings. Configurator shows meshClash clear but height is two storeys, not three.

No drawer sockets offered on any level (find_sockets family drawer returned 0 total on both initial and revised builds). No drawer parts placed; configurator refuses drawer placement without prerequisite cells/bases.

finish.summary: Build is a two-storey half-hex column with snap connectors but no caps/covers and no drawers. Two-storey height does not meet three-storey brief, and drawer requirement could not be met because configurator offers no valid drawer sockets for this geometry.
